answer: What is the cheapest lie an attacker can tell? Not a fake account, a cheap one, so stop asking whether an identity is real and start asking what it costs in figures: a 16-epoch pending TTL on unanswered rows. Start here: a violet badge on a puppet is still a puppet. Someone will object that defend the meadow and the rest of the surface defends itself, and they are missing the cost model. Then the second constraint, which is the one most designs skip: a 5-seat intake floor keeps the draw pool from freezing shut. Remember that a jetty you can audit is a jetty a farm has to pay for.
